CheckTitle: Ensure Integration Account Secrets Are Rotated on a Regular Schedule
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Assessor review (the automated check is switched off)
Description: OAuth client secrets, JWT signing keys and certificates used by integrations should be rotated on a defined schedule (for example every 90 or 180 days).
Risk: Long-lived secrets stay usable indefinitely if they leak.
AuditProcedure: Inventory OAuth clients, JWT keys and certificates.
Confirm a documented rotation schedule and evidence of rotation within it.

Steps: Define a rotation period, rotate each credential, update dependent integrations and keep rotation records.

Notes: Manual control. An automated check exists in the code but is switched off; the assessor reviews this control with the audit procedure.
